super_nodes.label: DFT tools, databases, and ML potentials
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of DFT codes and parameters, materials databases, and early machine-learning models for materials/molecular property prediction.

super_nodes.label: DFT convergence methods and MEGNet components
super_nodes.gloss: Mix of DFT electronic-structure convergence/mixing techniques (Pulay, Harris-Foulkes, Davidson) and MEGNet neural-network building blocks; no single unifying topic.

super_nodes.label: Automated ML pipelines and benchmarking
super_nodes.gloss: Covers ML software (TensorFlow, scikit-learn, DeepMD), the Automatminer/Matbench automated pipeline and benchmark, and related uncertainty-quantification components.

super_nodes.label: Materials databases and property screening
super_nodes.gloss: Findings and stats about the Materials Project and JARVIS databases: their scale, tools, and high-throughput screening for material properties.

super_nodes.label: Interatomic potentials and DFT accuracy
super_nodes.gloss: Classical and machine-learned interatomic potentials (Tersoff, Brenner, GAP, Behler-Parrinello) alongside claims benchmarking DFT functional accuracy against experiment.

super_nodes.label: Optimization and convergence in potential training
super_nodes.gloss: Mix of numerical optimizers (Adam, conjugate gradients), DFT convergence settings, and training/loss-schedule techniques for fitting interatomic potentials like NASICON/LLZO models.

super_nodes.label: Graph neural networks for molecules/crystals
super_nodes.gloss: Graph convolution and message-passing neural network architectures (MPNN, CGCNN, GCN) and their components, applied to molecular and crystal property prediction.

super_nodes.label: DFT+U correction methods and variants
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly DFT+U/Hubbard-correction variants (LDA+U, GGA+U, Dudarev, Liechtenstein) and their parameters, plus a few unrelated GNN/kernel-method citations (GRU, GDML).

super_nodes.label: Atomic structure descriptors and featurizers
super_nodes.gloss: Structural descriptors and featurization schemes for atoms/materials, including Coulomb-matrix variants, SOAP, CFID, and many-body descriptor sets.

super_nodes.label: ConvLSTM prediction of crystal fracture
super_nodes.gloss: A ConvLSTM model predicts crack patterns and fracture toughness from molecular dynamics simulations, generalizing across crystal orientations and bicrystal interfaces.

super_nodes.label: JARVIS platform components and tools
super_nodes.gloss: The JARVIS integrated infrastructure: its DFT/FF/ML/Tools modules, REST-API, and apps for heterostructure and Wannier tight-binding design.

super_nodes.label: GAP potentials for carbon structures
super_nodes.gloss: GAP machine-learned potentials for amorphous, liquid, and crystalline carbon, validated against DFT, plus related melt-quench and surface-slab simulation workflows.

super_nodes.label: DFT methods, databases, and ML models
super_nodes.gloss: Mix of DFT codes/pseudopotential methods (VASP, PAW, USPP), materials databases (ICSD, Pauling File), and various ML/materials models (CGCNN, RooSt, SNAP).

super_nodes.label: MEGNet components and Davidson method
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly MEGNet neural-network architecture pieces (blocks, layers, ResNets) plus the unrelated Davidson block diagonalization scheme and WaveNet.

super_nodes.label: Iterative training pipelines for potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Iterative/active-learning training and data-cleaning pipelines for ML potentials (DeePMD, convolutional LSTM), built on frameworks like TensorFlow and Keras.

super_nodes.label: Materials Project, AFLOW, and OQMD databases
super_nodes.gloss: Facts and stats about major computational materials databases: Materials Project, AFLOW/AFLOWLIB, OQMD, and Matbench's data sources.

super_nodes.label: Miscellaneous cited authors and methods
super_nodes.gloss: A loose group of cited authors/papers (Wang, Schmidt, Xie & Grossman, etc.) plus pymatgen and a couple of specific methods; no unifying topic.

super_nodes.label: Interatomic potentials and MD methods
super_nodes.gloss: Classical and neural-network interatomic potentials (Behler-Parrinello, Deep Potential, Tersoff/Brenner), plus MD barostats and a couple of alloy thermodynamic models.

super_nodes.label: Optimization algorithms for geometry and models
super_nodes.gloss: Optimization techniques spanning geometry relaxation (Adam, early stopping) and automated model search (TPOT genetic algorithm), plus the Franzblau ring-finding algorithm.

super_nodes.label: Graph neural networks for molecules/crystals
super_nodes.gloss: Graph convolution and message-passing neural network architectures (MPNN, CGCNN, GCN) and their components, applied to molecular and crystal property prediction.

super_nodes.label: Set2Set pooling and test sets
super_nodes.gloss: Centers on the Set2Set readout/pooling method, alongside various benchmark and validation test sets (CSP Blind Test, random displacement, MD-induced distortion).

super_nodes.label: DFT+U variants and GRU-based GNNs
super_nodes.gloss: DFT+U/Hubbard-correction variants (LDA+U, GGA+U, GW@LDA+U) alongside GRU-based graph network components and the GDML kernel method; a mixed set.

super_nodes.label: Normalization and scaling techniques
super_nodes.gloss: A broad collection of normalization and scaling techniques (kernel, batch, composition-weighted) spanning ML kernels, neural-network training, and DFT many-body methods.

super_nodes.label: Coulomb matrix descriptors and CUR decomposition
super_nodes.gloss: Coulomb-matrix-style structural descriptors together with CUR matrix decomposition and sparsification techniques for representing non-grid atomic/spatial data.

super_nodes.label: Phonon and electronic band-structure prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Methods and tasks for computing and predicting phonon dispersion/vibrational properties and electronic band structure/band gap, including GAP and frozen-phonon approaches.

super_nodes.label: SOAP and many-body atomic descriptors
super_nodes.gloss: SOAP and CFID-style many-body structural descriptors (two-body, three-body, hierarchical) used to represent atomic environments for ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: ACE-family tensor-based interatomic potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Tensor/cluster-expansion-based ML interatomic potentials (ACE, MTP, GAP) and their extrapolation and uncertainty-estimation challenges.

super_nodes.label: DFT exchange-correlation functionals and basis sets
super_nodes.gloss: DFT exchange-correlation functionals (PBE, hybrid HSE06/PBE0, meta-GGA) together with basis-set and atomic-density representations for electronic structure calculations.

super_nodes.label: OQMD, QM9, and OC20 datasets
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of DFT codes (Quantum ESPRESSO) and materials/molecular datasets, mainly OQMD and OC20-family catalyst datasets, plus QM9.

super_nodes.label: DFT+U and high-throughput DFT standards
super_nodes.gloss: DFT+U correction methods and the AFLOW standard for reproducible, automated high-throughput DFT, including their computational cost/accuracy tradeoffs.

super_nodes.label: Electronic minimizers and NASICON training
super_nodes.gloss: Electronic-structure minimization algorithms (RMM-DIIS, DBS, conjugate-gradient) and training/annealing protocols used to fit potentials for systems like NASICON.

super_nodes.label: DFT SCF mixing and correction methods
super_nodes.gloss: DFT self-consistent-field convergence techniques: Pulay charge mixing, Harris-Foulkes force/stress corrections, the Blöchl tetrahedron method, and projector-augmented waves.

super_nodes.label: Loss scheduling and gradient optimization
super_nodes.gloss: Training techniques for ML interatomic potentials: multi-term/progressive loss weighting, gradient evaluation, conjugate-gradient relaxation, and related optimization methods.

super_nodes.label: MD17 molecular dynamics benchmark datasets
super_nodes.gloss: The MD17 benchmark set of small organic molecules (benzene, aspirin, ethanol, etc.) in original and revised versions, used for ML potential testing.

super_nodes.label: Automatminer and Matbench benchmark suite
super_nodes.gloss: The Automatminer automated ML pipeline (autofeaturization, AutoML presets) and the Matbench benchmark suite used to evaluate it.

super_nodes.label: Random forests and feature selection
super_nodes.gloss: Tree-based ML methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) via scikit-learn, plus feature-selection and dimensionality-reduction techniques like PCA and Gini importance.

super_nodes.label: FireWorks workflow and carbon/water datasets
super_nodes.gloss: The FireWorks workflow-management tool (with STATIC/BANDS calculation steps) alongside a set of water, ice, diamond, graphite, and liquid-carbon structure datasets.

super_nodes.label: Softplus activations and tight-binding methods
super_nodes.gloss: Two threads: shifted/modified softplus activation functions for smooth potential-energy surfaces, and tight-binding/Wannier90 Hamiltonian generation methods.

super_nodes.label: GAP model for silicon vs DFT
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly validation of the GAP potential for silicon against DFT (elastic constants, surfaces, defects), plus separate DFT functional accuracy claims like HSE06 for ZnO.

super_nodes.label: Benchmark results for GNN property models
super_nodes.gloss: Quantitative benchmark results comparing neural-network property predictors (SchNet, MPNN, MEGNet, CGCNN, DeePMD) on datasets like QM9, MD17, and ISO17.

super_nodes.label: Automating workflows and ML pipelines
super_nodes.gloss: Problems and infrastructure (AFLOW workflow engine, FireWorks) for automating large-scale DFT campaigns and ML pipelines, addressing bias, reproducibility, and manual effort.

super_nodes.label: Battery and solid-electrolyte materials screening
super_nodes.gloss: High-throughput screening and ML/DFT modeling of battery materials: Li-ion anodes, solid-state electrolyte ionic diffusion, and LPSO Mg-alloy precipitates.

super_nodes.label: Molecular dynamics methods and software
super_nodes.gloss: Molecular dynamics methods and simulation software (ASE, VASP, LAMMPS, ab initio/Car-Parrinello/classical-force-field MD) used to generate training data for ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: ConvLSTM prediction of crystal fracture
super_nodes.gloss: A ConvLSTM model predicts crack patterns and fracture toughness from molecular dynamics simulations, generalizing across crystal orientations and bicrystal interfaces.

super_nodes.label: Force-field training and quality assessment
super_nodes.gloss: Training and benchmarking of force fields/force predictors (JARVIS-FF, CFID, SchNet), covering force/virial prediction, energy conservation, and force-field quality metrics.

super_nodes.label: Materials property prediction benchmarks
super_nodes.gloss: Benchmarking materials-property prediction (Matbench tasks, JARVIS-ML models) with emphasis on elastic/mechanical properties like bulk modulus, shear modulus, and Young's modulus.

super_nodes.label: JARVIS platform components and tools
super_nodes.gloss: The JARVIS integrated infrastructure: its DFT/FF/ML/Tools modules, REST-API, and apps for heterostructure and Wannier tight-binding design.

super_nodes.label: K-point and configuration-space sampling
super_nodes.gloss: Sampling strategies: Monkhorst-Pack/Brillouin-zone k-point meshes for DFT, and configuration-space/phase-space sampling (NVE/NVT, snapshot extraction) for training ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: DFT convergence criteria and cutoffs
super_nodes.gloss: Plane-wave cutoff and electronic/ionic convergence criteria for DFT calculations, plus automatic k-point convergence protocols and related preprocessing techniques.

super_nodes.label: Atomic Cluster Expansion with magnetism
super_nodes.gloss: The Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) extended to vectorial, tensorial, magnetic, and charge degrees of freedom, with related force/torque and energy-decomposition formulas.

super_nodes.label: Error metrics for energy prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly MAE/RMSE error metrics for energy, force, and formation-energy prediction, plus a few benchmark claims comparing Automatminer, graph networks, and activation energies.

super_nodes.label: Uncertainty quantification and error handling
super_nodes.gloss: Gaussian-process-based uncertainty quantification for ML predictions, paired with automated error-detection and self-healing/auto-restart techniques for failed calculations.

super_nodes.label: Topological search for interstitial sites
super_nodes.gloss: AFLOW's topological algorithms for finding and characterizing interstitial cage sites in crystal structures, including symmetry reduction.

super_nodes.label: Convex-hull phase stability analysis
super_nodes.gloss: AFLOW-based convex-hull construction and phase-diagram/stability-ranking methods for assessing thermodynamic stability of crystal structures and alloys.

super_nodes.label: GAP potentials for carbon structures
super_nodes.gloss: GAP machine-learned potentials for amorphous, liquid, and crystalline carbon, validated against DFT, including transferability and large-scale simulation challenges.

super_nodes.label: STM image analysis pipeline
super_nodes.gloss: A pipeline for simulating and classifying STM images, using distance binning, neighbor sorting, Tersoff-Hamann simulation, and gradient-boosting classification.

super_nodes.label: Surface slab modeling and energetics
super_nodes.gloss: Building and evaluating surface slabs and reconstructions (surface energy, stability, nanoparticle/dimer/trimer models) to overcome empirical-potential limits in surface description.

super_nodes.label: AFLOW command-line tools and generators
super_nodes.gloss: AFLOW utility tools: the Aconvasp command-line tool, Apennsy analysis module, and generators for nanoparticles and VASP POSCAR input/output files.

super_nodes.label: Cross-validation techniques and metrics
super_nodes.gloss: Various cross-validation schemes (k-fold, nested, stratified, grouped, leave-one-cluster-out) and evaluation metrics like ROC-AUC and MAE used to assess ML models.

super_nodes.label: Compositional featurizers and one method
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly a set of compositional/structural featurizers (atomic orbitals, element property, symmetry, Ewald energy), plus one unrelated method (EquiformerV2) with no shared theme.

super_nodes.label: Melt-quench molecular dynamics simulation
super_nodes.gloss: Melt-quench simulation protocol: temperature ramping, Nosé-Hoover thermostatting, and trajectory generation used to create quenched atomic configurations.

super_nodes.label: Structural and statistical analysis techniques
super_nodes.gloss: Analysis techniques for amorphous/liquid structures: ring statistics, radial and angular distribution functions, Arrhenius plots, and Poisson ratio.
